gloss_en: the 'gathering in' (removal/nullification) of the disgraces (charafot) that beset a person — identified with the three impure kelipot associated with the foreskin — accomplished through circumcision/guarding the covenant (as in 'God has gathered in my disgrace' at Joseph's birth and 'today I have rolled away the disgrace of Israel')
canonical_he: נאספו החרפות, הינו השלש קלפות כנ"ל
